observed_problem: A proposed cognition-only patch was selected before proving the rest of the UAOS control plane was sound. Full-scope review showed that the existing domain/runtime topology remained usable, but the control plane had three coupled coherence defects: stale derived bootstrap/status projections could lag semantic owners; every detected problem forced external research regardless of risk; and ChangeProposal required a FailureClass even when an evaluated knowledge item, not an incident, was the legitimate source of improvement.

evidence: CURRENT_SYSTEM.json lagged the already-promoted runtime finalization/OpenAI Agents guardrail semantics until this refactor
ENTRYPOINT.md defines CURRENT_SYSTEM as part of minimal bootstrap
config/DELIBERATION_POLICY.json previously required EXTERNAL_METHOD_OR_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH for every detected problem
src/uaos/evolution/models.py previously required non-empty failure_class_ids for every ChangeProposal
UAOS already has an independent RAW_EVIDENCE -> CANDIDATE -> EVALUATED -> CANONICAL knowledge lifecycle

competing_root_hypotheses.reason: Adaptive search would reduce premature convergence but would not prevent stale bootstrap projections or allow legitimate knowledge-origin evolution.

Registered-domain ownership, authority hierarchy, runtime/storage and finalization-gate mechanisms are independently represented and tested; current evidence does not justify replacing those subsystems.

The observed defects share a control-plane cause: semantic ownership, risk-adaptive admission and learning-to-evolution origin semantics were not sufficiently coherent even though the underlying domain/runtime topology remained valid.
Native ChatGPT complete mediation remains unverified, but the three selected defects are reproducible inside repository authority and exist independently of host interception.

architecture_candidates.reason: Leaves reproduced projection drift, fixed research depth and incident-only proposal origins intact.
Cannot mechanically fail stale projections, enforce bounded candidate counts or gate knowledge-origin promotion.
Duplicates the control plane, increases latency/token cost and does not itself provide independent verification.
Extends existing cognition, architecture-experience, knowledge and evolution abstractions without replacing domain ownership or creating a second controller.

selected_changes: Add config/AUTHORITY_PROJECTION_POLICY.json and make CURRENT_SYSTEM a derived operational projection with CI freshness checks against semantic owners.
Upgrade canonical cognition to LIGHTWEIGHT / CONTRASTIVE / STRUCTURED bounded search modes while preserving the five existing hot-path primitives.
Require competing action candidates and NO_CHANGE baseline for structured/systemic cognition; same-model self-dialogue remains candidate generation, not independent verification.
Require bounded competing architecture candidates plus NO_CHANGE baseline for material control-plane/agent-experience changes.
Allow ChangeProposal origin from admitted EVALUATED/CANONICAL KnowledgeItem without fabricating a FailureClass; retain the same evaluation, complexity, promotion and post-promotion gates.
Reconcile CURRENT_SYSTEM and SYSTEM_MAP with the already-promoted finalization gate/OpenAI Agents SDK output-guardrail boundary while explicitly keeping native ChatGPT pre-send mediation unverified.

complexity_disposition.reason: One owner/projection contract is added to remove shadow-authority ambiguity; other changes extend existing executable abstractions.

initial_candidate_ci.finding: six cross-suite regressions exposed exact-version freezes and an unsynchronized structured-admission fixture

assurance_boundary: Candidate structural/regression evidence can prove repository-level contracts and promotion behavior. It does not prove native ChatGPT physically intercepts every natural-language response, nor does it prove future live reasoning quality is perfect. Those claims remain bounded to their verified host/runtime surfaces.
post_promotion_observation: Watch for projection freshness failures when semantic owners change.
Watch whether LIGHTWEIGHT mode avoids ceremonial research without allowing premature root-scope claims.
Watch whether CONTRASTIVE/STRUCTURED bounded search improves architecture decisions without creating excessive token/latency cost.
Watch knowledge-origin proposals for overgeneralization or attempts to bypass evidence maturity.
